learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a general understanding of mathematics and natural sciences and develop analytical thinking habits.
Build a knowledge base in fundamental topics related to Electrical-Electronics Engineering.
Develop the ability to identify, define, formulate, and solve engineering problems, and to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.
Acquire the ability and skill to analyze and design systems.
Translate theoretical knowledge into practice through laboratory and project work.
Effectively use current software and hardware.
Develop the ability to work individually and in a team.
Develop verbal and written communication skills. Effectively use a foreign language in professional life.
Awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning; ability to access information, monitor developments in science and technology, and continuously renew oneself.
Acquire professional responsibility and ethical awareness.

syllabus_topics: General concepts related to protection such as selectivity, speed, reliability.
Online impedance calculation in power systems.
Online impedance calculation in power systems. Potential drift, Grounding.
Types of circuit breakers and disconnectors and determination of selection criteria.
Investigation of basic operating structures of protection relays and analysis of their application areas.
Investigation of current and voltage transformers.
Generator, Transformer, transmission line and Motor protection systems.
Generator, Transformer, transmission line and Motor protection systems.
Grounding and shielding. Investigation of grounding systems. Grounding measurement.
Voltage rises in power systems. Investigation of surge arresters, lightning rods and arcing horns. Investigation of high voltage protection equipment.
Protection with low voltages. Insulation systems. Protection against short circuit and fault current.
Combined heat and power generation systems, cogeneration.
